program='''from collections import deque

def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c] == 8 or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            comp = []
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                comp.append((y, x))
                for dy, dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy, xx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and g[yy][xx] != 8 and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            r0, r1 = min(y for y,x in comp), max(y for y,x in comp)
            c0, c1 = min(x for y,x in comp), max(x for y,x in comp)
            colored = [(y,x) for y,x in comp if g[y][x] != 0]
            if not colored:
                continue
            tr0, tr1 = min(y for y,x in colored), max(y for y,x in colored)
            tc0, tc1 = min(x for y,x in colored), max(x for y,x in colored)
            th, tw = tr1-tr0+1, tc1-tc0+1
            tile = [[g[tr0+i][tc0+j] for j in range(tw)] for i in range(th)]
            for y in range(r0, r1+1):
                for x in range(c0, c1+1):
                    if g[y][x] == 0:
                        g[y][x] = tile[(y-tr0)%th][(x-tc0)%tw]
    return g
'''
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
p.write_text(program)
print(p, p.stat().st_size)
